Status (System Map) Screen The Status screen allows access to system wide information. The information displayed is a quick reference of current system operation. • On the home screen press the Menu Menu button. • Press the Status Icon. Status *For even more information about the installed equipment press the icon of any of the installed devices. Programming Your Personal Touch Your Touch Screen Communicating Control has a wide variety of features and settings to be used. Access these features using the Menu button located on your Home screen. Menu Main Menu is used to view/edit important functionality of your system. These settings apply more to your installed HVAC equipment, then to the touch screen control itself. *In heat pump systems Emergency Heat can be activated from this screen. This will disengage the heat pump and utilize the backup heat source when a heating demand is present. Emergency Heat Fan Humidity Status Settings Dealer Tools Clean Schedule Alert: Change Filter Close The Settings screen is used to customize the Touch Screen Communicating Control. You can adjust brightness level, sound, temperature display, etc. So that your touch screen is customized to your preferences. You can create personalized schedules and assign them to a yearly calendar by season or by month. To assign your schedules: Press Schedule icon (located in the thermostat main menu. Schedule Press the Assign to Calendar button. Assign to Calendar Schedule Create or edit schedules Energy Saver New Schedule 1 Schedule 2 Edit Schedule 3 Copy Delete Viewer Import/ Export Assign to Calendar Cancel Save • Press the Up/Down arrows to highlight the schedule to assign. • Press the area of the calendar and the desired months or seasons will be highlighted with the assigned schedule color. These settings can be changed by using the shortcut shown on the Home screen. Press the Fan or Humidity icon on the home screen (this is a short cut to Fan/Humidity Adjust screen). Fan or Humidity Fan has up to three modes: Auto: Fan only runs with a call for conditioning. Manual: User can adjust fan speed and time for fan to run when no conditioning is required. Schedule: Fan runs per scheduled settings.
